status_detail: The two-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4: the real guardOutputOverlapStack over all five trigger geometries (front+back incl. the cc:1329 pre-existing-output branch, back-only, front-only) projecting op order, both SUBPIECE truncate constants, PIECE slots and the write entry, plus the cc:1336/cc:1358 call shapes in both endian routings. Overall remains UNTESTED because the BE-space guard routing cannot be staged through the transitional enum AddressSpace model (helper-level BE arithmetic is pinned in case 2), the guardCalls->tryOutputStackGuard production entry is not driven (the cc:1407-1430 output-contains branch is a declared conservative-false residual), and negative sizeFront/sizeBack geometries are unreachable from getBiggestContainedOutput containment.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-heritage-subpiece-const-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.endianness: little (stack/ram/register); a big-endian processor space ram_be exists for the case-2 arithmetic rows only
architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3 (LE), register=4 (LE), stack=5 (spacebase over ram, LE, base register R0:8 grows negative), ram_be=6 (BE, case-2 only), iop=7; byte addressed, wordsize 1
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/AddrSpace inserts ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace, three IPTR_PROCESSOR AddrSpaces and a SpacebaseSpace with an addSpacebasePointer register-space pointer; FixtureArchitecture registers core types, TypeOp instructions and a decoded default ProtoModel (Funcdata's ctor routes FuncProto::setScope -> setModel(defaultfp), fspec.cc:3879-3884, before ScopeLocal::resetLocalWindow)

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: default model <prototype name=subpieceguard extrapop=0 strategy=standard> with two register inputs (RSI 0x30, RDI 0x38) and one register output (RAX 0x0); entries are inert for the direct guardOutputOverlapStack drive
compiler_spec.calling_convention: no FuncCallSpecs staged; guardOutputOverlapStack is driven directly on a one-CALL Funcdata (cc:1329 both getOut()==null and pre-existing-output branches)

analysis_options.api: Direct production Heritage::guardOutputOverlapStack and Address::justifiedContain calls on both sides; no Action, Rule, PrintC or pipeline pass
analysis_options.model_state: per geometry: one Funcdata (name sg, ram base 0x60x0, size 0x20), one basic block, one CALL op with an 8-byte constant target 0x4000; case 1 drives the guard and projects the block; case 2 evaluates the cc:1336/cc:1358 call shapes in both endiannesses
analysis_options.normalization: None. Op lines print the numeric opcode (CALL=7, INDIRECT=61, PIECE=62, SUBPIECE=63; Ghidra's get_opname(CPUI_INDIRECT) prints DELAY_SLOT while Rugra's name() prints INDIRECT, so numbers are the shared stable code), varnode descriptors are <hexoff>:<size>:<I|W|F>{ah} with constants c<size>(<value>) and the iop annotation as IOP; the varnode SPACE letter is deliberately not printed (Rugra's transitional new_varnode_out register-space output vs Ghidra's range-space output is a registered projected-away divergence that cannot affect the constants, order or sizes)
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all geometries are valid containments

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: production guardOutputOverlapStack (heritage.cc:1322-1375) driven directly per geometry: addr/ret in the LE stack space; geometries (addr,size,ret,retsz) = (0x1000,16,0x1004,4), (0x2000,8,0x2002,4), (0x3000,8,0x3000,4), (0x4000,12,0x4002,10), (0x5000,16,0x5008,4 with the call output pre-created so cc:1329's getOut()!=null branch runs)
cases.queries: per geometry: one gs line (addr,size,ret,retsz,sf,sb), one op line per block op in insertion order (opcode number, input descriptors incl. the SUBPIECE constant value, output descriptor) and the write-list entry
cases.expect: LE constants: front SUBPIECE c4(0) (cc:1336, op2==addr), back SUBPIECE c4(sizeFront+retSize) = c4(8)/c4(6)/c4(4)/c4(12) (cc:1358, addrBack=ret+retsz); block op order [subF, subB, indF, indB, CALL, concatF, concatB] (cc:1327 insertPoint chain: back concat AFTER front concat); SUBPIECE outputs and INDIRECT in[0]s are W (cc:1340/cc:1362 opSetOutput def wiring); final write varnode carries ah (cc:1373)

observation_schema.format: 47 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, two case headers, five geometry groups (gs + 7/7/4/4/7 op lines + write) and 5 sp rows
observation_schema.op_lines: numeric opcode + input descriptors (constants print their value: c4(8) is the decisive back-piece constant) + output descriptor; state chars I/W/F pin the cc:1340/cc:1362 def wiring, op order pins the cc:1327/1349-1350/1371 insertPoint chain
observation_schema.constant_rows: sp rows pin the endian-routed cc:1336/cc:1358 arithmetic in both routings

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: guardOutputOverlapStack mutates the Funcdata (creates newInput/SUBPIECE/INDIRECT/PICECE/newVarnodeOut varnodes and ops, sets the call output when absent) and appends the final vnCollect to the write vector (cc:1374); Address::justifiedContain is a pure int4 return
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: no loops inside the function; the op-order observation pins the opInsertBefore/opInsertAfter insertion sequence (newIndirectOp inserts before the call, then the SUBPIECE before the call, concats after the running cc:1327 insertPoint which advances to concatFront at cc:1350)
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: sizeFront = retAddr - addr and sizeBack = size - retSize - sizeFront computed once up front (cc:1325-1326); no counters
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: justifiedContain decision keys op2.offset < offset and off2 > off1 are trivially satisfied (exact containments); the distance branch key is the range space's endianness with forceleft=false (address.cc:138)

coverage.front_back_constant: MATCH (5/5 rows in both endian routings)

coverage.production_entry_wiring: UNTESTED (proposed residual: the guardCalls -> tryOutputStackGuard production entry is not driven; Rugra's try_output_stack_guard conservatively returns false for the cc:1407-1430 output-contains branch, a declared RUGRA-GAP)

residuals.detail: BE-space full-function guard routing: the enum AddressSpace model is little-endian-only; helper-level BE arithmetic pinned (sp be rows).

Covered projection (LE full-function + both-endian arithmetic) MATCH; the fix replaced both hardcoded SUBPIECE constants with the endian-routed justified_contain_range values, restored the cc:1327 insertPoint concat chain, routed cc:1340/cc:1362 through op_set_output and unblocked the cc:1329 read-lock self-deadlock.

The cc:1407-1430 output-contains branch of tryOutputStackGuard (truncate the call output down to the range, cc:1420 fourth justifiedContain call site) remains a declared conservative-false residual; needs the locked output storage model.
